_comment: Manifest for skill families vendored verbatim from an upstream repo (no shared git history, so the merge-based sync-upstream.yml workflow cannot refresh them). Each entry: name = short id used in logs/report; upstream = <owner>/<repo> to clone; ref = branch/tag to check out; subdir = path inside the upstream clone that holds the skills; dest = local directory that subdir overwrites; exclude = upstream paths (relative to subdir) never copied into dest; license = 'upstream:<path in upstream clone>' to copy that file to '<dest>/LICENSE' after the overwrite, or 'local' when dest/LICENSE is locally authored (upstream ships none) and must survive the overwrite untouched; version_from = a JSON file inside the upstream clone whose .version fills the README's 'Upstream version' row, or null when upstream has no version to report; readme = the category README whose provenance table gets updated in place; plugin = the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugin whose skills array is checked against the skill directories under dest (mismatches are reported, never auto-edited).
